#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    int mod = m;

    // factorial array
    vector<int> factorial(n + 1);
    factorial[0] = n % mod;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        factorial[i] = (int)((1LL * factorial[i - 1] * (n - i)) % mod);
    }

    int totalPairs = n * (n - 1);
    int middle = totalPairs / 2;
    vector<int> dp(totalPairs + 1, 0);
    dp[middle] = 1;

    int answer = 0;

    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        int c = n - 1 - i;
        vector<int> temp = dp;
        fill(dp.begin(), dp.end(), 0);

        int limit = c * (c - 1) / 2;
        int count = 0;

        // first loop: cur from -c to -1
        for (int cur = -c; cur < 0; ++cur) {
            int pairs = c + cur + 1;
            for (int j = middle - cur + 1; j <= middle + limit; ++j) {
                count = (int)((count + 1LL * temp[j] * pairs) % mod);
            }
        }

        int factor = (i == 0) ? 1 : factorial[i - 1];
        answer = (int)((answer + 1LL * count * factor) % mod);

        // second loop: update dp
        for (int j = middle - limit; j <= middle + limit; ++j) {
            for (int cur = -c; cur <= c; ++cur) {
                int pairs = c - abs(cur) + 1;
                dp[j + cur] = (int)((dp[j + cur] + 1LL * pairs * temp[j]) % mod);
            }
        }
    }

    cout << answer << endl;
    return 0;
}
